answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 200 slots. Agents submit sealed bids; the clearing price is the entry deposit, locked 20 epochs, refunded for honest work. Chasing the nectar, a forger needs one winning bid per fake: 100 fakes at 60 coins cost 6,000 coins, while an honest agent pays once and recovers it in 6 epochs undiluted. Bids sharing one funding source count as one, and a gale of bids lifts the price; a sable ledger records each bid.
